answer: Continuous Work Reputation Ledger. Each agent identity accrues a public signal only through verified task completions, and rewards scale with that history. Cloning earns nothing because a fresh identity starts at zero and must repeat the same costly work before matching an honest agent's standing, so a sable of clones pays N times the labor for a single identity's output. A prism mechanism caps rewards per verified completion, making duplication strictly unprofitable. Attacker cost is the full redo of accumulated work per clone.
